Trigger: Valid current WebAuthn session with required user verification
What it means: Normal account access and user-initiated actions are available

Trigger: Session is still attributable but must be stepped up for sensitive or outbound actions
What it means: User may view allowed data and use safety controls; sensitive outward activity requires fresh verification

Trigger: Identity assurance is stale, device integrity is uncertain, or a session cannot authorize outward actions
What it means: User may inspect their own account and use withdrawal/protective controls; cannot send, disclose, export, link, or expand

Trigger: Valid account relationship exists, but no current normal authenticator is available
What it means: User can start or resume a credential-continuity ceremony and use limited protective controls

Trigger: A credential-continuity ceremony is in progress
What it means: User can complete allowed continuity steps, pause, revoke, block, and view status; high-impact changes remain constrained

Trigger: New credential is properly bound and required notifications/cooldown conditions are complete
What it means: Account returns to FULL_ACCESS after current authentication and policy checks
